guest: Old soul, especially Bill Withers; he loves finding a record with a bit of history.
reply: Bill Withers and a record with a story—there’s a useful lead for Marc’s wandering. When you come back to rest, are there any room or sleep comforts that matter to either of you?

threads.detail: Returning for the tenth anniversary of meeting; will revisit the port, where they met over a folded paper map. Nothing else planned yet.
Welcome a little private note about still happily getting lost together; no public fuss or rose-petal production. A wish, not an arrangement.
Enjoy slow wandering with long coffee stops.
Stops to sketch old building facades.
Enjoys secondhand record shops, old soul especially Bill Withers, and records with history.
